paras: AI at Home is a short guide for the chat app you already use. Every job has four parts: the problem, the exact words to paste, what a good answer looks like, and your next click.
I’ve replaced a faucet and recaulked a bathroom with AI help. I still have a lawyer, an accountant and a broker. I use AI to learn what to ask and to follow a process.
You can ask any chat app anything. The guide gives you the exact words, what a good answer looks like, and the check to run yourself.
The first job is the plant doctor: tell the AI its job, describe the leaves, and run the check it names. The same four parts cover:

• Recipes and dinners
  • A trip
  • A part you cannot name
  • Your internet bill
  • A Windows device that stopped working
  • An old computer
  • The check engine light
  • A slow tire leak
Shorter jobs cover an appliance, paperwork, and school emails.

paras: $7 USD for a digital file, a 19-page PDF. Nothing is shipped.
If it is not for you, email elvin@elvinpeters.com within 30 days for a full refund.

I tried the ten main jobs in Claude. I did not test other chat apps. The shorter jobs use the same method and were not each tried. For a damaged tire, a gas smell, or anything burning, call a person. The AI can be wrong. This is not medical, legal, financial, or safety advice.
